act.name: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing Hindu marriage, judicial separation, divorce, maintenance, alimony and child custody.

sections.title: Divorce.
sections.text: Section 13 sets out the statutory grounds on which a marriage may be dissolved by a decree of divorce.
sections.plain_language_summary: Lists legal grounds for divorce, including cruelty, desertion and other grounds specified by the Act.

sections.title: Divorce by mutual consent.
sections.text: Section 13B provides for divorce by mutual consent where the statutory conditions are satisfied.
sections.plain_language_summary: Allows spouses who mutually agree and meet the statutory conditions to seek divorce together.

sections.title: Maintenance pendente lite and expenses of proceedings.
sections.text: Section 24 provides for interim maintenance and litigation expenses during matrimonial proceedings.
sections.plain_language_summary: A spouse without sufficient independent income may seek interim maintenance and case expenses while proceedings are pending.

sections.title: Permanent alimony and maintenance.
sections.text: Section 25 empowers the court to award permanent alimony and maintenance in matrimonial proceedings.
sections.plain_language_summary: The court may order ongoing or lump-sum maintenance after matrimonial relief.

sections.title: Custody of children.
sections.text: Section 26 enables the court to make orders concerning custody, maintenance and education of minor children.
sections.plain_language_summary: The matrimonial court can decide interim and final arrangements for minor children's custody, support and education.
